 We’re now just days away from the release of GTA 6, the biggest gaming release of the decade and one that fans of the series have been waiting over 13 years for. It’ll debut on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on Nov. 19, and with Black Friday deals starting to flow, now is the perfect time to pick up a new gaming headset before the big day.

 Here, I’ve collected a few options that will help you enjoy the game without bothering your housemates. Some will even improve the experience with surround sound features, while others are all about that wireless freedom. There should be a headset for everyone, so all you need to do is pick the right one for your needs, your wallet and, most importantly, your chosen platform.

 Do all headsets work with PS5 and Xbox?
 Many wired headsets will work just fine with both the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, although it’s always worth checking the specifications. Sometimes the headset will work, but the microphone won’t, so it may not matter for GTA 6, but it would become an issue when playing online multiplayer games, for example.
 More from CNET
 Are wired or wireless headsets the best option?
 Choosing a wired or wireless headset will depend on how you play your games and where. Wired headsets are usually cheaper, and they have the added benefit of not needing to be charged. But wireless headsets often have better features, so it’s important to check the individual models before ordering. Sometimes, it’s just nice not to have to worry about a cable dangling from your head, too.
